description: Set up or change localize (backend URL, models, search, which tools to use automatically via auto_use). No arguments: effective config, where each value comes from, config file paths, detected backend API, reachability and the backend's model list. With {set, scope}: merge keys into the user or project config file (null removes a key). Changes apply on the next call without a restart. Call this first on a new machine.

set.description: Keys to change. Valid keys: base_url, api, api_key, headers, model, offload_model, delegate_model, research_model, search_url, research_sources, page_timeout_ms, allow_private_urls, num_ctx, max_tokens, keep_alive, concurrency, timeout_ms, test_timeout_ms, max_attempts, link_dirs, log_path, auto_use.

name: configure
